translation_notes: prefixes: owl->owl, rdfs->rdfs, d3fend->d3fend, skos->skos; the module-level `Namespace(...)` definitions of the original become `@prefix` (the RDF.type / RDFS.label / d3fend["attack-id"] / d3fend[revoked_by] forms become `a`, `rdfs:label`, `d3fend:attack-id`, `d3fend:{revoked_by}`)

the 4 / 5 / 6 consecutive adds on attack_uri of each branch become ONE `+{ s a owl:Class ; ... }` per branch (15 adds -> 5 islands); `owl:deprecated True` is the Turtle boolean `true` (Literal(True) is "true"^^xsd:boolean)

`Literal(x)` on a string is the plain interpolation `{x}`; mod_label / attack_id / pref_label / comment_text are strings in every call (labels come from STIX names); had one been None, the original would write the literal "None" and the interpolation would raise TypeError -- `{Literal(x)}` is the fully faithful form

`build` is not importable here (the installed `build` is PyPA's, and the repository's own build.py defines no `_xmlns`): context_shim.py carries `_xmlns`, a `get_graph` stub, and VERBATIM copies of get_framework_labels, get_deprecated_comment, ensure_superclasses and the tactic tables from update_attack.py
`@graph graph` declared in the function after `attack_uri`; ensure_superclasses(graph, ...) keeps its rdflib calls (outside the region)
optimization_notes: optimized.py: the three adds every branch shares (rdf:type owl:Class, rdfs:label, d3fend:attack-id) are hoisted into one `graph += [...]` before the `if`; the revoked branch's three remaining adds become a second list; `key = ""` and the `key = ...` assignments become direct returns. The five `tech[...]` reads stay up front, so a missing key still raises before the graph is touched (inlining them would move that KeyError after the skos:prefLabel add).

optimized.ldpy, from optimized.py: the same structure with `+{ {attack_uri} a owl:Class ; rdfs:label {mod_label} ; d3fend:attack-id {attack_id} }`, `owl:deprecated true` for Literal(True), `d3fend:{revoked_by}` for d3fend[revoked_by], and a bare f-string plain literal for the revoked comment. No exception to the symmetry rule.

Notation difference not exercised by the driver: on a revoked technique whose `revoked_by` is None, `d3fend[None]` raises TypeError in the original and optimized.py, while `d3fend:{revoked_by}` writes the IRI `d3fend:None`. The translator's note on `{x}` with x None (Literal(None) is "None", the interpolation raises) applies here too.
graph is a plain Graph in the repository (build.get_graph), so `graph += [...]` adds to it exactly as `.add` does.
header_optimization_notes: optimized_header.py: `BNode` and the shim's `get_graph` go (unused); the owl/rdfs/d3fend/skos Namespaces, RDF, RDFS, URIRef and Literal stay.
optimized_header.ldpy: the rdflib import keeps only `URIRef` (attack_uri) and `get_graph` goes; the four @prefix lines are all used and stay.
